curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who traffic laws cover, why speed is dangerous, the basic speed law, statutory and minimum limits, and where to slow down.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per speed rule; contrast cards for the statutory limits by road type.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a road type or condition and asking for the limit or speed rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where to stop at a STOP sign, stops from alleys and for school patrols, turns on red, dead and flashing signals, and other required stops.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each required stop and turn-on-red rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an intersection and asking where or whether to stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover when to stop for a school or church bus, the divided highway exception, and amber versus red lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each bus rule; a contrast card for amber versus red lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a road and a bus and asking whether you must stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the uncontrolled intersection rule, emergency vehicles, blind pedestrians, driveways, yield signs, left turns and green arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking who must yield in a scenario.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain passing dangers, how to pass on the left, being passed, passing on the right and shoulders, and where crossing the center line is banned.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a road and asking whether you may pass.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover where to watch for pedestrians, driver and pedestrian duties, following emergency vehicles and fire hoses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each pedestrian and emergency rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on pedestrian duties and emergency vehicles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach safe backing, shoulders and window obstructions, lane changes and hand signals, improper turns, and load limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on backing, hand signals and load limits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through a traffic stop, then the insurance law and minimums, window tint limits and the move-over law.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for moving over versus slowing down.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on traffic stop conduct, insurance minimums, tint and move-over.
